def find_shortest_cycle(adj, n):
    """Find the length of the shortest cycle in the graph. Returns inf if acyclic."""
    best = float('inf')
    for start in range(n):
        parent = {start: -1}
        depth = {start: 0}
        q = deque([start])
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for v in adj[u]:
                if v not in depth:
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                    parent[v] = u
                    q.append(v)
                elif v != parent.get(u, -1) and parent.get(v, -1) != u:

                    if cycle_len < best:

import z3

min_edges = 29

def has_short_cycle_from_edges(edges, max_len=7):
    adj = defaultdict(set)
    for u,v in edges:
        adj[u].add(v)
        adj[v].add(u)
    
    for start in range(n):
        parent = {start: -1}
        depth = {start: 0}
        q = deque([start])
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            if depth[u] >= (max_len + 1) // 2:
                continue
            for v in adj[u]:
                if v not in depth:
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                    parent[v] = u
                    q.append(v)
                elif v != parent.get(u, -1) and parent.get(v, -1) != u:
                    cycle_len = depth[u] + depth[v] + 1
                    if cycle_len <= max_len:
                        # Reconstruct the cycle
                        cycle = []
                        cur = u
                        while cur != -1:
                            cycle.append(cur)
                            cur = parent.get(cur, -1)
                        cur = v
                        while cur != -1:
                            cycle.append(cur)
                            cur = parent.get(cur, -1)
                        return True, cycle
    return False, None
